resources.string: Choose what to send or receive, then review the matches. Only song metadata goes to your paired PC, when you start a sync.
Matches use title, artist, album and duration. Missing or ambiguous songs are skipped. No audio files are transferred.
Merge adds songs and keeps existing order and names. It never removes favorites or playlist entries. Smart playlist rules stay on their original device.
Select fewer collections. Each sync can review up to 10,000 song references.
Sync stopped. Completed batches are kept. Retry safely without duplicating entries.
This PC version does not support library sync. Update ECHOSteam, then try again.
Complete PC pairing first. Direct LAN connections can browse music, but cannot sync collections.
